key.name: show-virtual-memory
key.description: Additionally draw a bar for virtual memory (swap + zram).

key.name: arrangement
key.description: rows: the two bars are stacked vertically. columns: the two bars sit side by side horizontally.

key.name: bar-order
key.description: Order of the bars. "memory" first means the memory bar is on top (rows) or on the left (columns).

key.name: bar-direction
key.description: ltr: the bars fill from left to right, so 0% sits on the left edge. rtl: the bars fill from right to left, so 0% sits on the right edge.

key.name: rotate
key.description: Rotate the whole drawing 90 degrees clockwise, so the bars fill from top to bottom.

key.name: per-bar-size
key.description: When enabled, the memory and virtual memory bars use their own width and corner radius in the rows arrangement. When disabled, both bars share bar-width and corner-radius.

key.name: memory-width
key.description: Thickness (width) of the memory bar when the bars are stacked vertically.

key.name: virtual-width
key.description: Thickness (width) of the virtual memory bar when the bars are stacked vertically.

key.name: memory-radius
key.description: Corner rounding of the memory bar when the bars are stacked vertically.

key.name: virtual-radius
key.description: Corner rounding of the virtual memory bar when the bars are stacked vertically.

key.name: color-background
key.description: Color of the empty part of the bars in the light theme. Supports an alpha channel: #rrggbbaa.

key.name: bar-length
key.description: Length of a single bar in pixels, i.e. its horizontal extent.

key.name: bar-width
key.description: Thickness (width) of a single bar in pixels. When the bars are stacked vertically this also decides the total height.

key.name: bar-gap
key.description: Space in pixels between the two bars.

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Corner rounding of the bars in pixels. 0 draws plain rectangles.

key.name: update-interval
key.description: Refresh interval in milliseconds.

key.name: color-memory
key.description: Color used for the memory bar in the light theme.

key.name: color-swap
key.description: Color used for the swap segment of the virtual memory bar in the light theme.

key.name: color-zram
key.description: Color used for the zram segment of the virtual memory bar in the light theme.

key.name: dark-brightness
key.description: Brightness factor applied to all colors when a dark style is in use.
